description:
Token-saving file reader with AST-aware diff caching. Use INSTEAD of the standard Read tool for ALL file reads — even first reads gain chunk metadata for future savings.

• First read: full content + chunk metadata (enables future savings)
• Re-read unchanged: ~50 tokens (99% savings)
• Re-read modified: only changed chunks (50-90% savings)

Especially effective for files >200 lines. Always prefer this over Read.

force.description: Return full content regardless of cache

name: read_smart
